sampling: Reconstruct the exact accepted v0.10.1 method-specific seeded <=30000-pixel mask, including the discarded preliminary NK draw; pass it as xDEM inlier_mask with subsample=1.0. Retain xDEM internal gradient/bin/filter choices.
external_to_sampling: (-shift_x,-shift_y,+shift_z); native xDEM matrix is geolocation translation
convergence: Observe unmodified xDEM iteration-step returns via a temporary recording wrapper restored in finally; NK accepted only if finite and final horizontal statistic <0.01 pixels after >=3 iterations. Reaching 30 iterations alone is not success.
acceptance: Fit samples >=100 across >=3 64px blocks, finite translation strictly inside horizontal bound, explicit convergence, held-out support >=64 across >=3 blocks. Held-out RMSE is descriptive and is not used to tune/reject fits.
pair_comparison: Original WB pair records vs external fits before graph adjustment, evaluated on an identical per-pair intersection across all accepted WB/external corrections.
network: Same frozen 4-node, equal-edge-weight least squares; 2016 anchor; only accepted edges. Graph differences retained and reported.
final_support: Intersection of original RUN14 comparison support and all four epochs in every successful external network. All 9 frozen WB network solutions recomputed/verified against content fingerprints and evaluated on this exact support.
resampling: Common Workbench apply_vector (bilinear, full finite support); xDEM native apply equivalence checked synthetically only. This is an estimator comparison with common downstream processing, not an end-to-end xDEM benchmark.
demcoreg_reason: GDAL/pygeotools runtime requires separate validation; not silently substituted with a reimplementation.
limits: Candidate reference windows can change in vegetation/snow; they are not surveyed stable controls.
Software agreement does not establish true terrain change or absolute accuracy.
W_SLUMP is a fixed observation window, not the full Batagay boundary.
Same-day shared images and shared DEM nodes correlate errors; cycle rank does not count statistically independent observations.
A failed network is excluded transparently, never replaced by another method.
Existing holdouts are development diagnostics, not a fresh independent final validation set.
